title: East Coast Offsite — ground ops scratchpad
content:
Purpose: quick-running personal ops scratchpad for the East Coast engineering offsite (week of Apr 6). This is messy — intended for on-the-ground use: packing checklists, vendor numbers, expense reminders, and small process notes.

High-level plan (reminder):
- Wed afternoon arrival window for core team (reception and badge pickup 3–5pm)
- Thu full day: sessions + lunch + breakout rooms; AV check 7:30am
- Fri half day, travel windows after 1pm

Venue basics
- Venue: Harborview Conference Center (Ballroom B + 2 breakout rooms)
- Address: 112 Dockside Ave, Pier 3, South Harbor, MA 02110
- Venue contact (onsite coordinator): Priya Rao — +1 (617) 555-0142 — onsite from Wed 9am–10pm
- Main phone (switchboard): +1 (617) 555-0100
- Loading dock / deliveries: Dock door 4, arrive between 8–9am for AV load-in. Call Priya on arrival.
- Wifi: Harbor-Guest (ask for code at registration). Confirm that vendor APs won’t conflict.

AV & staging checklist (Avery’s quick ops)
- AV vendor: SoundScope Media — contact Elias Moreno (cell: +1 781-555-0933) — booked for full-day Thu.
- Confirm 2 wireless lav mics + 2 handhelds for Q&A
- Projectors: 2x main screens, 1x presenter laptop HDMI adapter (dongles: USB-C and DisplayPort)
- House sound level: confirm mic test at 7:30am Thu
- Backup: battery-powered speaker & spare aux cable in red kit bag
- Tech rider link: https://drive.redwood.ai/file/d/av-rider-ec-offsite.pdf (placeholder — upload final)

Catering & dietary notes
- Caterer: Local Bite Catering — point: Hannah Li, +1 617-555-0228
- Thu lunch: boxed lunches (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free options) + bottled water; avoid celery (allergy note from 2 attendees)
- Breakfast: continental + coffee station — set up at 7am Thu
- Evening: light cocktail hour (cheese/fruit/vegan dip) Thu 6–7pm — confirm staffing until 8pm
- Expense note: tip included in invoice? If not, we reimburse up to 18% as out-of-pocket — save receipt and note on expense form

Local vendors and quick contacts
- Shuttle / van service: HarborShuttle — Sam (ops): +1 617-555-0466 — reserved 3 vans Wed/Thu morning (confirm count 48h prior)
- Last-mile courier: RedRun Logistics — order code RR-EC-26, contact: Joyce Ng, +1 617-555-0199
- Emergency locksmith +0: Locksmith Express — +1 617-555-0701 (for last-minute door code resets)

Accommodation & rooming notes
- Team hotel: South Harbor Lodge (blocks under Redwood Inference — group code: REDW-EC26)
- Check-in times: standard 3pm; earliest hold for late arrivals — ask front desk to hold key packets for arrivals after 10pm with name list (see below)
- Rooming list to hotel by Mar 20 (TODO)
- Per diem guidance: company policy allows $70/day for meals when on full-day offsite; keep receipts for anything >$25; conference receipts must be attached to expense form

Expense reminders (my SOP quick list for submitters)
- Company expense form: https://finance.redwood.ai/expenses (attach itemized PDF receipts)
- Use GL code: OFFSITE-TRAVEL-26 for domestic travel; EVENT-SUPPLIES-26 for small purchases < $100
- When paying vendor with corporate card, note 'pcard' in expense memo to avoid duplicate reimbursement
- Tip/catering: include line item and total tip amount; if tip paid in cash and reimbursed, write the vendor name and reason on the receipt photo
- Currency: everything in USD (we’re US-based). If vendor charges tax-exempt, capture certificate in linked files

Device & kit checklist (red bag) — pack these in carry for quick deployment
- 2x USB-C -> HDMI dongles, 1x DisplayPort adapter
- 1x portable projector remote + 2x AA batteries (spares)
- 1x battery-powered speaker + aux cable
- 1x ethernet cable 25ft + small travel switch (in case wifi flaky)
- Label maker + gaffer tape + sharpies (black + silver)
- Extension cord + power strip (3 outlets min)
- Printed attendee list + printed run-of-show (2 copies)

Attendee admin (things to confirm 72h prior)
- Final headcount for lunch and name badges (send to Local Bite + Harborview)
- AV run-of-show to Elias (include slide deck timings, mic transitions)
- Shuttle passenger names to HarborShuttle; note any mobility assistance needs
- Confirm dietary restrictions for 6 people (Maya to send list)

Quick sample expense lines (for reference when filing):
- 2026-04-06 Local Bite Catering - Lunch - $1,152.00 - EVENT-SUPPLIES-26 - receipt: PDF
- 2026-04-05 SoundScope Media - AV rental - $980.00 - OFFSITE-TECH-26 - receipt: PDF
- 2026-04-06 HarborShuttle - Van service - $320.00 - TRAVEL-GROUND-26 - receipt: PDF

Unresolved / Questions to chase down
- Do we need a signed hold-harmless for the hotel's outdoor patio for cocktail hour? (Priya said 'likely yes') — follow up with legal and venue
- Is there a minimum staffing overtime charge from Local Bite after 7:30pm? Check menu contract Appendix A
- Confirm whether projector inputs are VGA-only in Breakout 2 — if so, we need adapters for at least 3 laptops

Day-of run-of-show (short) — Thu
- 07:15 AV onsite tech arrives, test mics
- 08:00 Staff check-in + bag drop open at registration table
- 09:00 Opening remarks (20')
- 12:10 Lunch break (60') — staggered seating to reduce lines
- 13:15 Breakouts (2x 40')
- 15:30 Lightning talks (6 x 7') + open Q&A
- 17:45 Transition to cocktail hour

Handy Slack channels / call trees
- #eng-offsite (announce changes, emergency pings)
- #events-ops (vendor invoices, prepay confirmations)
- Phone tree: Avery -> Diego -> Maya -> Priya (call chain if venue can't locate our equipment)

Notes-to-self (Avery)
- Print extra 20 badge stickers and a few blank name tags (for walk-ins)
- Bring a roll of clear labels and spare business cards to hand when vendors ask for PO contact
- If any invoice looks handwritten, take a photo of the vendor license/ID and add note on expense form

Quick timeline tasks (by date)
- Mar 20: finalize rooming list to hotel & confirm shuttle manifest
- Mar 25: finalize catering dietary list and send to Local Bite
- Mar 28: AV vendor final run-of-show and slide timing file due to Elias
- Apr 02: double-check all invoices and confirm prepayments

If something breaks: immediate triage
1) Prioritize safety and mobility — call venue/safety first
2) If AV problem, quick swap to backup speaker + hand mics; push slides to presenter laptops
3) For missing meal items, ask Local Bite for immediate replacement platter or reimburse staff to order nearby (save receipts)

End of scratchpad — commit the essentials to Confluence later. Keep this doc as the quick, editable bag-of-tricks for the venue day.

-- Avery
